notes: Southern Maryland version: mirrors the College Park Mechanical Engineering plan (me-major); the requirements are identical, so the same plan is used. Its official flag and placeholder notes carry over below.

A. James Clark School of Engineering official Fall 2026 Mechanical Engineering graduation plan. General-education slots (ENGL101, Oral Communication, Professional Writing, Scholarship in Practice, Humanities, History/Social Sciences) are left out: only the program's own requirements are audited here (they're covered by gen-ed-2026-27.ts).
The chemistry lecture sequence (Year 1 Fall) is filled with CHEM135 (the plan's own scheduled course), not the CHEM131/CHEM134 alternate.
ENES100 and ENES102 are each offered 'Year 1 Fall or Spring' on the plan; filled here as ENES102 (Fall) and ENES100 (Spring), matching the plan's own default first listing in each term.

The 'ENME 332 or ENME 400' slot is filled with ENME332 in Year 3 Spring (the plan's own default first listing there); ENME400 is filled in Year 4 Fall (the plan's default first listing for that term's paired slot). Both courses are required regardless of which term each is taken in.
The 'ENES200 or ENEE200' slot (Year 2 Fall) is filled with ENES200, as printed first on the graduation plan and catalog table; ENEE200 would satisfy the requirement equally.

The five Technical Elective slots (Year 4 Fall x2, Year 4 Spring x3) are filled with ENME442, ENME454, ENME489C, ENME489E and ENME489Q, all from the department Bachelor of Science page's own Technical Electives list; any five qualifying courses totaling 15 credits would satisfy the requirement.
